items.description: Map the repository modules, research artifacts, and data flow before changing the plan
items.acceptance_criteria: Create a repo map note that explicitly explains the roles and connections of `.archivara/concept_evolve.py`, `.archivara/semantic_scholar.py`, `.opencode/tools/concept_evolve.ts`, `.opencode/tools/semantic_scholar.ts`, `.opencode/agents/concept-tree-explorer.md`, `.opencode/agents/literature-graph-miner.md`, and the `results/` subfolders, including how tool wrappers feed Python runners and how those runners populate literature, swarm, concept, and verification artifacts.
items.notes: Mapped the repo control/data flow in results/repo_map.md, repaired the ConceptEvolve evolve runner, ran the mandatory evolve kickoff, and wrote results/concept_evolve/steering_notes.md from the generated concept cards and bridge chains.

items.description: Lock the exact mathematical problem statement and align it with the director swarm before any implementation
items.acceptance_criteria: Read `results/swarm/hypotheses.json`, `results/swarm/tool_plan.md`, and `results/swarm/director_brief.md`, then write a definition lock that fixes the domain of `r`, the meaning of subsequence, the coefficient ring and nondegeneracy conditions for the recurrence, the allowed selector families, and the pre-registered slope/modulus panel from the director brief; no implementation work starts before this artifact exists.
items.notes: Locked the arithmetic meaning of subsequence and recurrence in results/definition_lock.md, fixed the selector-family scope, recorded the degeneracy policy, and froze the director-brief slope/modulus panel before baseline implementation.

items.description: Extend the saved literature snapshot with targeted web search, Semantic Scholar search, and code-repository search
items.acceptance_criteria: Update `results/literature/literature_snapshot.json` in place rather than rebuilding from zero; log targeted web and academic searches for Beatty sequences, Sturmian/mechanical words, linearly recurrent subshifts or S-adic systems, generalized polynomials, Skolem-Mahler-Lech, and Pisot/Salem mechanisms; add at least 12 relevant sources and either at least 2 relevant code or formal-tool references or an explicit negative finding after targeted repository searches.
items.notes: Updated results/literature/literature_snapshot.json in place with a curated 15-source map, logged targeted Semantic Scholar searches across Beatty/Sturmian/LR/S-adic/GP/SML branches, recorded a low-signal recommendation pass, and added Walnut/Pecan plus a negative repository-search finding in results/literature/repository_search.md.

items.description: Create and maintain the citation base and live prior-art gap log
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `sources.bib` in the repo root and keep it current with BibTeX entries for at least 10 relevant papers, including `Central sets generated by uniformly recurrent words`, one Skolem-Mahler-Lech reference, one generalized-polynomial reference, and `Beatty Sequences for a Quadratic Irrational: Decidability and Applications`; fill `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` with non-empty differentiation notes, evidence artifacts, and pivot decisions for every currently named closest paper.
items.notes: Created sources.bib with 15 relevant BibTeX entries, including the central-sets, SML, generalized-polynomial, and quadratic-Beatty anchors, and filled results/literature/prior_art_gap.md with differentiation evidence and pivot decisions for every named watchlist paper plus the active math branches.

items.description: Delegate literature-graph mining and novelty triage before committing to a theorem direction
items.acceptance_criteria: Use at least one delegated exploration pass and one synthesis pass, such as `literature-graph-miner`, to produce a memo with at least 3 citation chains and an overlap table that explicitly addresses `Louisville Seamount Trail: implications for geodynamic mantle flow models and the geochemical evolution of primary hotspots`, `Central sets generated by uniformly recurrent words`, `Weakly continuous functions on Banach spaces not containing`, and `A Data Prefetch Mechanism for Accelerating General-Purpose Computation`; cross-link the memo from `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md`.
items.notes: Ran one delegated literature-graph-miner pass, then synthesized the returned citation chains, overlap table, avoid-list, and theorem-direction recommendation into results/literature/literature_graph_memo.md and cross-linked it from results/literature/prior_art_gap.md.

items.description: Freeze the baseline benchmark matrix before building any checker
items.acceptance_criteria: Write a pre-registered panel spec that fixes slopes `2`, `3/2`, `5/3`, `phi`, `sqrt(2)`, the plastic constant, one Salem example, and `e`; selector families arithmetic progressions, finite unions of arithmetic progressions, Ostrowski-definable selectors, and linear-recursive selectors; recurrence orders `d = 1..4`; and moduli `2, 3, 5, 7, 11` plus one prime-square follow-up for survivors, with no post-hoc expansion unless logged as a blocker.
items.notes: Froze the benchmark matrix in results/baseline/panel_spec.json and results/baseline/panel_spec.md, including the named slope panel, low-slope controls, concrete selector templates, d=1..4, moduli 2/3/5/7/11, and the prime-square follow-up 25.

items.description: Implement an exact arithmetic baseline for detecting recurrence subsequences under frozen selector classes
items.acceptance_criteria: Build a baseline checker that uses exact integer or rational arithmetic, reports the candidate recurrence coefficients and witness indices for every positive hit, cleanly recovers the rational arithmetic-progression baseline, and rejects floating-point or finite-prefix-only evidence as insufficient.
items.notes: Implemented the exact arithmetic baseline in special_numbers/, including exact SymPy floor evaluation and rational-nullspace recurrence detection, and verified it with results/baseline/baseline_smoke.json plus the design note in results/baseline/checker_design.md. The smoke run recovers the rational AP baseline and explicitly downgrades an uncertified phi/Fibonacci fit to finite_prefix_fit_insufficient.

items.description: Add modular-shadow and eventual-semilinearity diagnostics to the baseline pipeline
items.acceptance_criteria: For every candidate positive case, record residue behavior modulo `2, 3, 5, 7, 11` and one prime square when needed, and classify the outcome as exact recurrence, prefix fit, sparse-subsequence leak, or selector-shadow failure using a consistent artifact schema.
items.notes: Added modular-shadow diagnostics in special_numbers/diagnostics.py, recorded residue behavior mod 2/3/5/7/11/25 in results/baseline/modular_shadow_smoke.json, and formalized the artifact schema in results/baseline/modular_shadow_schema.md. The smoke run distinguishes a certified rational exact recurrence from prefix and selector-shadow failures.

items.description: Define the metric suite, logging schema, and blocker taxonomy for all baseline runs
items.acceptance_criteria: Create a metrics spec that every run must emit, including exact_hit_rate, false_positive_rate on adversarial controls, modulus_consistency_score, selector_complexity, selector_density_class, runtime, and blocker tags for rational-triviality, word/value confusion, set/sequence confusion, and post-selection leakage.
items.notes: Defined the run-level metrics and blocker taxonomy in results/baseline/metrics_spec.json, implemented metrics aggregation in special_numbers/metrics.py, and emitted results/baseline/metrics_smoke.json with exact_hit_rate, false_positive_rate on adversarial controls, modulus_consistency_score, selector_complexity, selector_density_class, runtime_seconds, and blocker tags.

items.description: Delegate concept-tree expansion so baseline ideas are organized in `results/concept_evolve/tree/`
items.acceptance_criteria: Use a delegated exploration pass such as `concept-tree-explorer` plus a synthesis pass to populate or audit `results/concept_evolve/tree/`; the phase is complete only when the tree contains an index and at least 8 concept folders or a documented failure memo, and each surviving folder is tagged as aligned with H1, H2, H3, or retire with one proposed baseline experiment.
items.notes: Ran one delegated concept-tree-explorer audit, tagged all 11 concept folders with H1/H2/H3/retire plus one baseline experiment in concept.json, regenerated results/concept_evolve/tree/index.json with the actual underscore folders, and added results/concept_evolve/tree/tree_audit.md plus active_graph.json.

items.description: Develop the champion H1 modular-shadow and p-adic semilinearity program on the locked selector classes
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce a concrete research memo for H1 that states the exact claim being pursued, the recurrence profiles and selector classes it covers, the role of modular-shadow or p-adic arguments, and the remaining proof obligations; every statement must be traceable to the frozen benchmark panel rather than ad hoc examples.
items.notes: Wrote results/core/h1_modular_shadow_memo.md with the theorem-backed H1 claim for AP/FUAP selectors, the modular-shadow role for the zero-density lane, panel traceability, and the remaining proof obligations before any stronger theorem language.

items.description: Escalate to the H2 Pisot backup only if the champion leaves clean irrational survivors
items.acceptance_criteria: Either document that no irrational survivors remain after the H1 screen, or run the H2 backup on at least 3 named Pisot-type slopes and at least 3 matched non-Pisot or Salem controls using the same frozen constructions, with exact success or failure certificates recorded for each case.
items.notes: Activated the H2 backup because quadratic irrational survivors remain after H1, then ran the frozen even-convergent construction on three Pisot-type slopes (phi, 1+sqrt(2), plastic) and three controls (sqrt(2), Salem quartic, e). The exact success/failure certificates and the resulting verdict are recorded in results/core/h2_pisot_backup.md and results/concept_evolve/tree/005_convergent_hankel_detector/results.json.

items.description: Keep the concept tree synchronized with promoted and retired research bridges
items.acceptance_criteria: Update `results/concept_evolve/tree/` so that at least 3 branch folders contain current README or concept notes linking literature evidence, experiment status, and promotion or retirement decisions; write a delta artifact that lists promoted bridges, retired bridges, and next experiments.
items.notes: Synchronized the concept tree by updating folders 004/005/009 with literature-linked promotion decisions and experiment status, added status/experimental_result fields to their concept.json files, and wrote results/concept_evolve/concept_delta.md with promoted bridges, retired bridges, implemented techniques, and next experiments.

items.description: Delegate exploration and synthesis across H1, H2, and reserve H3 before narrowing the main claim
items.acceptance_criteria: Use at least one delegated exploration pass and one synthesis pass to compare the active H1 path, the conditional H2 backup, and the reserve generalized-polynomial H3 framing; store a go or no-go memo that chooses one primary route using evidence from experiments and literature rather than intuition alone.
items.notes: Ran one delegated comparison pass across H1/H2/H3 and synthesized the evidence-driven go/no-go decision into results/core/route_selection_memo.md. The primary route stays H1, H2 is kept as a conditional sparse-survivor lane, and H3 remains reserve only.

items.description: Run an explicit novelty screen against named watchlist papers and the closest real mathematical branches
items.acceptance_criteria: Update `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` and a draft `results/verification/novelty_report.md` with one comparison section each for `Central sets generated by uniformly recurrent words`, `Pisot numbers, Salem numbers, and generalised polynomials`, `Beatty Sequences for a Quadratic Irrational: Decidability and Applications`, `Louisville Seamount Trail: implications for geodynamic mantle flow models and the geochemical evolution of primary hotspots`, and `A Data Prefetch Mechanism for Accelerating General-Purpose Computation`; every section must end with one explicit material-difference sentence.
items.notes: Updated results/literature/prior_art_gap.md with explicit material-difference sentences for the named watchlist papers and active comparison branches, and drafted results/verification/novelty_report.md covering Central sets, Pisot/Salem generalized polynomials, quadratic Beatty decidability, Louisville Seamount Trail, and Data Prefetch.

items.description: Execute the full pre-registered experiment matrix without selector fishing
items.acceptance_criteria: Run or explicitly waive every combination in the frozen panel, including rationals, any allowed `0 < r < 1` cases, quadratic irrationals, higher-degree Pisot numbers, non-Pisot algebraic controls, Salem controls, and transcendental controls across the approved selector families and recurrence orders, with all skips justified in the artifacts.
items.notes: Ran the frozen panel in scripts/run_full_panel.py and saved results/experiments/full_panel_results.json plus results/experiments/full_panel_summary.csv. The run covers the primary slopes, low-slope controls, and the logged 1+sqrt(2) H2 follow-up, with all inapplicable Ostrowski/beta-endpoint cases explicitly waived and summarized in results/experiments/full_panel_memo.md.

items.description: Run the falsifier controls on the exact same panel and definitions
items.acceptance_criteria: Perform an adversarial replay that explicitly checks rational-triviality, sparse-subsequence leakage, prefix fitting, word/value confusion, and set/sequence confusion on the same selectors, slopes, moduli, and recurrence orders used by the main experiments; any failed control must be documented before moving on.
items.notes: Replayed the falsifier controls on the same full panel and exact definitions, then summarized the rational-triviality, sparse-subsequence, prefix-fit, word/value, and set/sequence audits in results/experiments/falsifier_controls.md. No failed control remained undocumented.

items.description: Benchmark the findings against the literature-derived baselines identified in Phase 1
items.acceptance_criteria: Create a comparison table that evaluates the project's results against at least 4 literature branches from the review, including one Beatty or Sturmian branch, one linearly recurrent subshift or S-adic branch, one generalized-polynomial branch, and one Skolem-Mahler-Lech or linear-recurrence branch, with every row citing sources from `sources.bib`.
items.notes: Created results/experiments/literature_baseline_comparison.md comparing the frozen-panel findings against the Beatty/Sturmian automatic branch, the linearly recurrent subshift/S-adic branch, the generalized-polynomial/Pisot-Salem branch, the SML branch, and the central-sets near-miss branch, with sources.bib keys on every row.

items.description: Obtain specialist verification artifacts under `results/verification/` before claiming novelty or completeness
items.acceptance_criteria: Use delegated specialist passes such as novelty_checker, citation_auditor, and benchmark_auditor to produce `results/verification/novelty_report.md`, `results/verification/citation_audit.md`, `results/verification/benchmark_report.md`, and `results/verification/verification_summary.md`; each artifact must contain a verdict, blockers, and recommended follow-up, and the summary must reconcile all three specialist reports.
items.notes: Ran three delegated specialist-style audits (novelty, citation, benchmark) and synthesized the results into results/verification/novelty_report.md, results/verification/citation_audit.md, results/verification/benchmark_report.md, and results/verification/verification_summary.md. The summary reconciles all three and leaves no internal must-fix blockers beyond keeping sparse quadratic claims narrow.

items.description: Consolidate error analysis, ablations, and robustness findings
items.acceptance_criteria: Publish an evaluation memo with at least 3 failure-case studies, 1 ablation on selector-family restrictions, 1 ablation on the modulus panel, and a clear separation between empirical observations, conjectural inferences, and theorem-backed conclusions.
items.notes: Wrote results/experiments/evaluation_memo.md with theorem-backed, empirical, and conjectural sections, three failure-case studies, one selector-family ablation, and one modulus-panel ablation backed by results/experiments/ablation_summary.json.

items.description: Synthesize the strongest supported claim as a theorem, conjecture, or impossibility statement with exact scope
items.acceptance_criteria: Write a final claim memo that states the domain of `r`, the allowed selector class, the exact meaning of homogeneous linear recurrence, the rational baseline, any surviving irrational families, and the strongest statement actually supported by the evidence.
items.notes: Wrote results/final_claim_memo.md, separating the theorem-backed AP/FUAP characterization from the experiment-backed quadratic-convergent survivor statement and the explicitly conjectural quadratic-only refinement.

items.description: Produce reproducible documentation and an artifact index for the whole research workflow
items.acceptance_criteria: Create a documentation bundle that explains how to reproduce the literature review, baseline checks, core experiments, concept-tree exploration, and verification passes; it must include a navigable artifact index for `results/`, `results/concept_evolve/tree/`, and `results/verification/`.
items.notes: Created results/reproducibility.md with the executable workflow and results/artifact_index.md as a navigable index over the literature, baseline, concept-tree, experiment, and verification artifacts.

items.description: Finalize citations and keep the prior-art differentiation record current through sign-off
items.acceptance_criteria: Expand `sources.bib` to at least 15 relevant entries, ensure every outward-facing claim cites at least one source, and fully populate `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` with final evidence artifacts, differentiation notes, and pivot decisions for all named closest papers and all active mathematical comparison branches.
items.notes: Expanded sources.bib beyond the 15-entry floor (including formal software references for Walnut and Pecan), kept final claim and comparison artifacts keyed to sources.bib entries, and left results/literature/prior_art_gap.md fully populated with evidence artifacts, differentiation notes, and pivot decisions for the named watchlist plus the active math branches.

items.description: Delegate writer and reviewer passes before the final package is accepted
items.acceptance_criteria: Run at least one delegated writing pass and one delegated review pass; the resulting draft and critique must explicitly check the category errors flagged in `results/swarm/falsifier.md`, especially word versus value recurrence, set versus sequence claims, exact identity versus approximation, and rational cases first.
items.notes: Ran a delegated writer pass and a delegated review pass, then saved the tightened outputs in results/final_package_draft.md and results/final_package_review.md. The review explicitly checked rational cases first, word-vs-value recurrence, set-vs-sequence claims, and exact identity vs approximation.

items.description: Close the loop by updating repository context and publishing a final research package summary
items.acceptance_criteria: Update `results/research_context.md` and `results/research_context.json` with final rubric counts, chosen direction, cited-paper count, concept-tree status, and verification status; the closing summary must point to `results/verification/verification_summary.md`, `sources.bib`, and the concept-tree index, and no unresolved blocker may remain undocumented.
items.notes: Updated results/research_context.md and results/research_context.json with the final direction, citation count, concept-tree status, and verification status, and wrote results/final_summary.md pointing to the verification summary, sources.bib, and concept-tree index.
